text:
Luisa: Quick sync 1 AcmeHW wants to upload one assurance bundle for the marketplace listing + our joint blog. They asked for a single format and an upload flow. Thoughts?

Marco: I'd prefer JSONL manifest (one object per artifact) instead of CSV; it's easier for SIs to include nested metadata like "origin" and "redaction_ranges". Example line: {\"filename\":\"soc2-summary.pdf\",\"sha256\":\"...\",\"type\":\"soc2\",\"redacted\":false} .

Sasha: JSONL is fine. Only ask is that we keep the schema stable: filename, sha256, type, redacted, contact, notes. No deep nesting.

Priya: Security asks: if partner includes firmware images, we need a signed firmware attestation (PGP or vendor-signed PDF) and a short description of the supply chain review. Also include KMS/HSM screenshots for private deployment proof.

Luisa: Good call. Acme says their pen vendor will only share an executive summary. Can we accept that?

Marco: We can accept exec summary + remediation.csv that lists findings, CVE, severity, status, and mitigated_date or ETA. If critical issues are open, we may delay announcement.

Sasha: Upload mechanism: presigned S3 links preferred. Recommend TTL 5-10 days. We avoid longer lived links. Also require uploads to a named prefix: s3://redwood-marketplace/acmehw/{version}/.

Luisa: Can you paste the presign CLI we give partners?

Marco: Sure, we usually send this template:

```
aws s3 cp assurance-package.zip s3://redwood-marketplace/acmehw/v1/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/acmehw/v1/assurance-package.zip --expires-in 604800
```

Sasha: Note: we ask partners to encrypt the ZIP with a passphrase and provide the passphrase via Zendesk secure note or signed email. No passphrases in the upload.

Ellen: Marketing timeline: we want draft by next Wednesday. We need security signoff before we publish. Jonathan is OOO but Priya can triage. Priya, can you provide a go/no-go checklist?

Priya: Yes. Checklist items: manifest.jsonl present, SOC attestation + summary, pen summary + remediation.csv, third-party scan summary (SCA/DAST), firmware attestation if applicable, contact for redaction questions, and confirmation of storage location. If all present and no critical findings, +1.

Luisa: Acme also asked about redaction guidance. Can we provide an example redaction note format?

Marco: Use redaction_ranges as an array of {start_line,end_line,reason} for text PDFs, and a boolean redacted flag for binary. In the manifest we include small free-form redaction_notes. Keep it human readable.

sec-bot: Reminder: Marketplace Intake page updated: https://intranet.redwood/marketplace-intake. Required artifacts: SOC attestation, pen summary, remediation tracker, manifest.jsonl, firmware attestation (if hardware), and support contact. See policy v2.1. :robot_face:

Sasha: One more nuance: Acme's legal asks if we can accept vendor-signed NDA redaction attestations instead of full redaction. We should accept vendor attest + sample redacted page for verification.

Priya: Agreed. If partner provides a vendor attestation and a sample redacted excerpt (sha256 included in manifest), that satisfies redaction auditability.

Luisa: Next steps: I'll DM Acme the JSONL manifest template, presign/upload instructions, passphrase guidance, and the 5-day TTL. I'll cc Sasha for SI mapping. I'll post back here when links are live. Thanks team :pray:
